newsitem.title: USA: California fireworks plant blast kills one.
newsitem.headline: California fireworks plant blast kills one.

text.p: An explosion ripped through a fireworks plant in southern California on Friday, killing one person as rockets and other aerial shells were being loaded for a public show, a fire official said.

Several people were reported injured in the blast and fire that followed at the "Pyro Spectacular" plant in Rialto, 50 miles (80 km) east of Los Angeles. Rialto Fire Department spokesman Kevin Brown said the cause was under investigation.

"A trailer was being loaded with explosive material including aerial shells when there was an explosion in the trailer causing the one fatality," he said. The fireworks were being loaded for shipping to a public display, he added.
